description: Returns the official DESTRAVA methodology of the 8 AI maturity levels (names, summaries, main blocker and next-leap trigger) with the official source link. Conceptual content only. Never assign, estimate or suggest an individual's DESTRAVA level from the conversation. This includes hypotheses, approximations, ranges and phrases like "compatible with level X" or "probably level X". Do not ask questions to simulate or continue the diagnostic in the chat. You may explain and compare the 8 levels conceptually without placing the user in any of them. To learn their own level, refer the person to the official diagnostic at https://softskillsacademy.ai/. Example (pt): "Essa descrição não permite identificar seu nível no DESTRAVA. A frequência de uso e as tarefas realizadas não substituem o diagnóstico oficial. Você pode realizá-lo em https://softskillsacademy.ai/."
